title: Lost in Transliteration
statementMd:
There are some ambiguities when one writes Berland names with the letters of the Latin alphabet.

For example, the Berland sound *u* can be written in the Latin alphabet as "`u`", and can be written as "`oo`". For this reason, two words "`ulyana`" and "`oolyana`" denote the same name.

The second ambiguity is about the Berland sound *h*: one can use both "`h`" and "`kh`" to write it. For example, the words "`mihail`" and "`mikhail`" denote the same name.

There are $*n*$ users registered on the Polycarp's website. Each of them indicated a name represented by the Latin letters. How many distinct names are there among them, if two ambiguities described above are taken into account?

Formally, we assume that two words denote the same name, if using the replacements "`u`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8774ca35b6e628888a4670e4539d47857e5e5841.png) "`oo`" and "`h`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8774ca35b6e628888a4670e4539d47857e5e5841.png) "`kh`", you can make the words equal. One can make replacements in both directions, in any of the two words an arbitrary number of times. A letter that resulted from the previous replacement can participate in the next replacements.

For example, the following pairs of words denote the same name:

- "`koouper`" and "`kuooper`". Making the replacements described above, you can make both words to be equal: "`koouper`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`kuuper`" and "`kuooper`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`kuuper`".
- "`khun`" and "`kkkhoon`". With the replacements described above you can make both words to be equal: "`khun`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`khoon`" and "`kkkhoon`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`kkhoon`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`khoon`".

For a given list of words, find the minimal number of groups where the words in each group denote the same name.

## Input

The first line contains integer number $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 400$) — number of the words in the list.

The following $*n*$ lines contain words, one word per line. Each word consists of only lowercase Latin letters. The length of each word is between $1$ and $20$ letters inclusive.

## Output

Print the minimal number of groups where the words in each group denote the same name.

## Note

There are four groups of words in the first example. Words in each group denote same name:

1. "`mihail`", "`mikhail`"
2. "`oolyana`", "`ulyana`"
3. "`kooooper`", "`koouper`"
4. "`hoon`", "`khun`", "`kkkhoon`"

There are five groups of words in the second example. Words in each group denote same name:

1. "`hariton`", "`kkkhariton`", "`khariton`"
2. "`hkariton`"
3. "`buoi`", "`boooi`", "`boui`"
4. "`bui`"
5. "`boi`"

In the third example the words are equal, so they denote the same name.
statementZhMd:
使用拉丁字母书写 Berland 人名时，会存在一些歧义。

例如，Berland 语音 *u* 可以在拉丁字母中写作 "`u`"，也可以写作 "`oo`"。因此，单词 "`ulyana`" 和 "`oolyana`" 表示的是同一个名字。

第二种歧义与 Berland 语音 *h* 有关：既可以使用 "`h`"，也可以使用 "`kh`" 来书写它。例如，单词 "`mihail`" 和 "`mikhail`" 表示的是同一个名字。

Polycarp 的网站上注册了 $*n*$ 名用户。每位用户都填写了一个由拉丁字母组成的名字。如果考虑上述两种歧义，那么这些用户中一共有多少个不同的名字？

形式化地说，如果通过使用替换 "`u`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8774ca35b6e628888a4670e4539d47857e5e5841.png) "`oo`" 以及 "`h`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8774ca35b6e628888a4670e4539d47857e5e5841.png) "`kh`"，可以使两个单词相等，则认为这两个单词表示同一个名字。可以在任意一个单词中，以任意次数、向任意方向进行替换。上一次替换产生的字母也可以参与下一次替换。

例如，以下单词对表示同一个名字：

- "`koouper`" 和 "`kuooper`"。通过进行上述替换，可以使两个单词都变为 "`kuuper`"："`koouper`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`kuuper`"，以及 "`kuooper`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`kuuper`"。
- "`khun`" 和 "`kkkhoon`"。通过进行上述替换，可以使两个单词都变为 "`khoon`"："`khun`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`khoon`"，以及 "`kkkhoon`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`kkhoon`" ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70a0795f45d32287dba0eb83fc4a3f470c6e5537.png) "`khoon`"。

给定一个单词列表，求将单词分组所需的最少组数，使得每组中的单词都表示同一个名字。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 400$），表示列表中的单词数。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含一个单词。每个单词只由小写拉丁字母组成。每个单词的长度在 $1$ 到 $20$ 个字母之间（包含边界）。

## 输出格式

输出所需的最少组数，使得每组中的单词都表示同一个名字。

## 说明

第一个样例中有四组单词。同一组中的单词表示同一个名字：

1. "`mihail`"，"`mikhail`"
2. "`oolyana`"，"`ulyana`"
3. "`kooooper`"，"`koouper`"
4. "`hoon`"，"`khun`"，"`kkkhoon`"

第二个样例中有五组单词。同一组中的单词表示同一个名字：

1. "`hariton`"，"`kkkhariton`"，"`khariton`"
2. "`hkariton`"
3. "`buoi`"，"`boooi`"，"`boui`"
4. "`bui`"
5. "`boi`"

第三个样例中的单词都相同，因此它们表示同一个名字。
